source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Record a detailed description of what happened during the accident.
3. Include the date and time the incident occurred.
4. Document the location where the accident took place with precision.
5. Identify and list all employees involved in the accident.
6. Provide a detailed description of the injuries sustained by each individual.
7. Note any witnesses to the accident and document their contact information.
8. Capture photographs of the accident scene, if possible, for evidence.
9. Document any immediate actions taken post-accident, including first-aid or medical intervention.
10. Record any equipment or machinery involved in the accident, noting if they were faulty or malfunctioned.
11. Include details of any hazard that contributed to the accident.
12. Document the rescue and clean-up process, if applicable.
13. Ensure that the injured employees have received proper medical attention.
14. Collect all incident reports and statements from involved parties.
15. Review the accuracy of the documentation with superv
